title: Monster wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 35,35 65,35' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 42,22 58,22' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <polygon points='42,22 35,35 50,35' fill='#4dd2ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='2' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='17' ry='4' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- monster body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#6bd44a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#a8f07a'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='68' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#54b838' transform='rotate(20 24 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='68' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#54b838' transform='rotate(-20 76 68)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='93' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#54b838'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='93' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#54b838'/>
  <!-- big eye -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='6' fill='#1a1a4d'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='59' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- little eye -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#1a1a4d'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M38 82 Q50 92 62 82' stroke='#2e5a1e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <polygon points='44,83 48,83 46,88' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='54,83 58,83 56,88' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <polygon points='34,52 28,38 40,48' fill='#f7a63c'/>
  <polygon points='66,52 72,38 60,48' fill='#f7a63c'/>
</svg>
